interfaces.name: accumulator_readout
interfaces.method: store-path width in the elaborated FIRRTL + the build's own attested ABI header
interfaces.evidence: StreamWriter io.req.bits.data : UInt<128> (= DIM x int8) in this elaboration, where the gemmini_rtl pin's is UInt<512> (= DIM x int32). Scratchpad.scala's `writer_data_width = if (acc_read_full_width) acc_w else spad_w` is where the absence lives -- AccumulatorMem's read request still carries a `full : UInt<1>` field and cannot witness it. The attested header agrees by omission: ACC_READ_SMALL_WIDTH is defined, ACC_READ_FULL_WIDTH is not.
interfaces.consequence: no int32 tensor can leave this device: the mvout path cannot move an int32 accumulator row, and the narrow path applies the accumulator scale and clips to elem_t (int8).
interfaces.l2_oracle_is_blind_to_this: MEASURED 2026-09-09, not inferred from source. A hand-written full-width int32 mvout for capsule A2_single_tile_matmul, compiled against this target's own attested ABI and run on this device's own Spike extension, returns bit-exact int32 and reports errors=0 -- a program this RTL cannot build. Cause, read in the extension source: the full-width accumulator read is implemented UNCONDITIONALLY off the address bit (spike_qualification/extension/gemmini.cc:222, 'bool const full = (sp_addr >> 29) & 0x1;', and :265, 'sizeof_output = full ? sizeof(acc_t) : sizeof(elem_t)'), not gated on ACC_READ_FULL_WIDTH. L2 must therefore NEVER be cited as evidence about this device's readout width.
